units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 15:27">Ex. R. s. 15</cite>, a. fr. <he>עשר מכות</he> (not <he>עשרה</he>) the ten Egyptian plagues.
Ib. ע׳ אנשים ten men; a. v. fr.—In compounds עָשָׂר, עֶשְׂרֵה, as אַחַד ע׳ eleven, שְׁנֵים ע׳ twelve &c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Rosh Hashanah 1:1">R. Hash. I, 1</cite> <he>בחמשה ע׳ בו</he> on the fifteenth day of it (the month of Shebat).
Pes. I, 1 אור לארבעה ע׳, v. אוֹר II; a. v. fr.—Pl. עֶשְׂרִים twenty.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 107a:8">B. Bath. 107ᵃ</cite> <he>ואחד אומר בע׳</he> and one of the experts says, it is worth twenty (Selaim).
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 5:21">Ab. V, 21</cite> <he>בן ע׳ לרריף</he> at the age of twenty years it is time to hunt (for a living); a. v. fr.
